research_rejections.title: Fullmetal Alchemist
research_rejections.reason: Deferred, not a taste rejection: IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes establish the 2003 51-episode adaptation and its dark fantasy/alchemy premise, and reviews describe meaningful action and emotional themes. However, available independently consulted whole-series criticism does not support sufficiently confident coverage of the complete 42-dimensional DNA record, especially the required guardrail dimensions and action density across the full run. Do not assign unsupported values or confuse this adaptation with Brotherhood.

research_rejections.title: Dragon Ball Super
research_rejections.reason: Not selected today: the 2015 television series offers escalating power and tournament combat, but independently corroborated full-series evidence was too uneven to establish reliable 42-dimensional DNA coverage. Public discussion notes inconsistent animation and arc quality; the discovered lead alone cannot establish title-specific quality or baseline eligibility.
